_meta.description: RBAC permission codes for the ecommerce platform.
_meta.enforcement: Three-layer: Server Component (requireAdminPermission) → Client UX (useAdminContext) → DB RLS (has_permission RPC)

customer.description: Regular authenticated user. No admin permissions.

admin.description: Staff member. Has only explicitly granted permissions.
admin.permissions: subset of all permission codes — assigned per user

super_admin.description: Full access. Bypasses all per-permission checks.

catalog:read.description: View products, variants, categories in admin

catalog:write.description: Create, update, delete products and categories

orders:read.description: View all orders across all customers

orders:manage.description: Update order status, process returns, issue refunds

customers:read.description: View customer profiles and order history

cms:read.description: View CMS pages, blocks, navigation in admin

cms:edit.description: Edit CMS page content, blocks, navigation items

cms:publish.description: Publish CMS content (both country and locale level)

cms:manage_country_content.description: Edit country-level CMS content (source of inheritance)

cms:break_inheritance.description: Break locale content inheritance from country (create locale override)
cms:break_inheritance.note: High-impact permission — creates divergence in content tree

cms:restore_inheritance.description: Restore locale content to inherit from country (removes override)

is_admin.description: Returns true if auth.uid() has role = 'admin' OR 'super_admin'
is_admin.used_in: RLS policies for all admin-accessible tables

has_permission.description: Returns true if auth.uid() is super_admin OR has explicit permission grant

layer_1_server_component.when: Before rendering any admin Server Component or before any admin API route handler
layer_1_server_component.side_effect: Logs to admin_action_logs table (errors swallowed — audit never breaks main request)

layer_2_client_ux.warning: UI-only gate. NOT authoritative. Server must always re-check.

layer_3_db_rls.when: DB RLS policies on admin-accessible tables
layer_3_db_rls.note: Final enforcement layer. Even if layers 1 and 2 are bypassed, DB rejects unauthorized access.
